name: crew
description: Throw an AI dev at a problem and have it own the outcome. Five Opus agents (router, scout, worker, critic, fresh-eyes) collaborate to investigate, plan, execute, and verify — SSH into systems, spin up infra, edit code, ship features, debug deploys, get airgap bundles working. Worker self-switches between investigating, planning, executing, and verifying modes. Bounded scout budget, multi-agent reflexion on stuck (N=2-3 parallel variants + judge), critic and fresh-eyes must produce evidence ledgers of commands they actually ran. One checkpoint (plan approval) for side-effecting tasks, zero for pure investigation. Plan and debrief render in chat; state files exist in .crew/runs/ for resume.
